description: Search government bid opportunities (open and past) by keyword, state, and buyer level. Results are relevance-ranked; keyword matches in the title outrank passing mentions in the description. Optionally filter by set-aside program (set_asides).

open_only.description: true = only bids whose deadline has not passed

set_asides.description: Set-aside programs, any of which matches: SDVOSB, VOSB, HUBZone, 8(a), EDWOSB, WOSB, DVBE, DBE, MBE, WBE, SBE, HUB, SDB, SBS; 'none' = the record says no set-aside was used (unrestricted). Many records are not marked either way, so a set-aside search never returns them.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. TX

name: search_bids
